story.soThat: I can keep customer information current
story.tasks: - Task 1: Implement PUT endpoint in CustomerController (AC: #1, #11) - Task 2: Create UpdateCustomerRequest DTO (AC: #2) - Task 3: Implement update logic with partial updates (AC: #2, #3, #7) - Task 4: Implement email uniqueness validation (AC: #6) - Task 5: Implement optimistic locking (AC: #10) - Task 6: Track field changes for audit trail (AC: #7, #9) - Task 7: Auto-update timestamps (AC: #8) - Task 8: Implement audit entry creation (AC: #9)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. PUT /api/v1/customers/{customerId} endpoint implemented 2. Accepts partial updates (only provided fields updated) 3. Returns 200 OK with updated customer object 4. Customer not found returns 404 Not Found 5. Validation errors return 400 Bad Request 6. Duplicate email returns 409 Conflict 7. Tracks which fields changed (before/after values) 8. updatedAt timestamp auto-updated 9. Audit entry created with before/after values 10. Optimistic locking: etag header prevents concurrent updates 11. Requires ROLE_CUSTOMER_SERVICE_AGENT or ROLE_ADMIN authorization

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: FR003: Update customer personal/contact details with audit trail. FR013: Audit logging for all data mutations (who, what, when, before/after values).

doc.title: Story 2.2: Customer Create API
doc.snippet: Story 2.2 established AuditService for CREATE operations. Story 2.5 extends it to track before/after field changes for UPDATE operations.

artifact.reason: Add PUT /{customerId} endpoint to existing controller.
Add updateCustomer(UUID, UpdateCustomerRequest) method with change tracking logic.

story-context.constraints: - Partial updates: Only non-null fields in request are updated - Email uniqueness: Check new email doesn't exist for other customers - Optimistic locking: Add @Version field to Customer entity, use etag header - Change tracking: Store before/after values for all changed fields - updatedAt auto-updated via JPA @PreUpdate listener - Audit entry includes before/after map: {field: {before: val1, after: val2}} - Authorization required: CUSTOMER_SERVICE_AGENT or ADMIN - Story 2.2 must be completed (CustomerService and AuditService exist)

interface.name: CustomerController PUT endpoint
UpdateCustomerRequest DTO

tests.standards: Testing standards require update tests with partial updates, change tracking tests, optimistic locking tests, and audit entry verification with before/after values.
tests.locations: - genapp-backend/src/test/java/com/example/cicsgenapp/controller/CustomerControllerTest.java (MODIFY - add PUT tests) - genapp-backend/src/test/java/com/example/cicsgenapp/service/CustomerServiceTest.java (MODIFY - add update tests)
tests.ideas: AC1: Controller test - PUT /api/v1/customers/{customerId} with update data, verify 200 status AC2: Service test - Partial update with only email field, verify only email updated, other fields unchanged AC3: Service test - Update customer, verify 200 OK with updated customer object AC4: Service test - Update non-existent customer ID, verify 404 Not Found AC5: Service test - Update with invalid email format, verify 400 Bad Request AC6: Service test - Update email to existing email (another customer), verify 409 Conflict AC7: Service test - Update customer, verify change tracker captures before/after values for modified fields only AC8: Service test - Update customer, verify updatedAt timestamp changed, createdAt unchanged AC9: Service test - Verify auditService called with before/after map for changed fields AC10: Integration test - Concurrent update with stale version, verify 409 OptimisticLockException AC11: Controller test - Update without CUSTOMER_SERVICE_AGENT role, verify 403 Forbidden
